protocol_note: Protocol B, registered 2026-10-07 after protocol A's two blind tests (widths 128 and 96) both came out below their 95% intervals. Over 1.5-2 decades of N on CPU, L_inf is not identifiable (refits pin it at 0), so the pre-registered predictor is the pure power law L = a N^-alpha with a Birge-inflated parametric bootstrap. Fit set = every trained width except the bigram-plateau width 8. Held-out width 192 has not been trained when this prediction is written.
